items.text: Springfield Warrior Sports has the perfect solution! Our innovative ninja warrio
items.full: Springfield Warrior Sports has the perfect solution! Our innovative ninja warrior classes are specifically designed to keep kids of all ages interested in exercising and fostering relationships while having fun at the same time. Our experienced coaches lead weekly classes full of obstacle courses, strength-building exercises, and more that will help boost physical fitness and encourage an active lifestyle. Plus, our competitive youth team offers an opportunity for young athletes who want to take their game up a notch!

items.full: The Springfield Warrior Sports Junior Warrior Classes are the perfect way to get your 7-18 year olds active and teach them the importance of a healthy lifestyle. These classes incorporate cardio, strength, balance, and agility training while teaching safe and productive ways to conquer the different obstacles in the gym. For kids who need a little extra one-on-one coaching, we also offer personal training tailored to their goals.

The Central States Ninja Association is a competitive youth team for Junior Warr
items.full: The Central States Ninja Association is a competitive youth team for Junior Warriors who are ready to take it to the next level and put their skills to the test! Junior Warriors are eligible to apply for the CSNA team upon completing Level 4. The team works with Coach Adam Arnold who holds 90-minute practices 2 days a week. The season runs September - May with competitions scheduled throughout the region hosted by other participating CSNA gyms |MO, KS, NE, AR|.

items.text: Learn the basics of Parkour |free running| in this group class. Students will ga
items.full: Learn the basics of Parkour |free running| in this group class. Students will gain the ability to move freely with and without obstacles using the abilities of their bodies. This will be accomplished primarily through running, jumping, climbing, and quadrupedal movements. Classes will focus on physical conditioning and Parkour skills and will ultimately blend the two together. Experience the non-competitive mental and physical challenge while building strength, speed, stamina, and balance in a controlled environment.

items.full: Looking for a fun and engaging way to keep your homeschoolers active? Springfield Warrior Sports has just what you need! Our homeschool program offers structured classes designed to help kids build strength, agility, and confidence—all while making friends and having a blast. Whether your child wants to challenge themselves on obstacles, improve their coordination, or just burn off some energy, we provide a safe and supportive environment to do it all. Sign up for our exciting classes—we can’t wait to see your homeschool warriors in action!
